item.title: Chilean OVERTOUN Unleash New Single + Video ‘Yūrei’
item.description: OVERTOUN have unveiled “Yūrei”, the second single taken from their upcoming third full-length album “Death Drive Anthropology”, due out on February 13th, 2026 via Time To Kill Records. Musically, “Yūrei” sharpens the band’s death–thrash core with an unsettling melodic tension, where tightly wound riffs, dynamic rhythmic shifts, and subtle Latin and folk-inflected nuances converge into a focused and oppressive atmosphere.
